tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, just below the proposed threshold range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe directly tests for the predicted change in slope before committing to an extrapolation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the threshold avalanche model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations lie below the proposed threshold, so neither the threshold nor the strength of the siphon can be estimated.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth Haldane or Cobb–Douglas law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies u_now and s_grad together, so its flattening does not distinguish smooth input effects from the below-threshold branch of an avalanche law.
It costs more and does not specifically target the missing above-threshold gradient regime.
